summary: This note is a short wiki-style entry about the 1968 Italian comedy film Riusciranno i nostri eroi a ritrovare l'amico misteriosamente scomparso in Africa?, directed by Ettore Scola. It notes the film's international title and its production start in 1965 under the working title "Mister Sabatini, suppongo". It also remarks that the film began a brief Italian vogue of very long titles.
one_line: A 1968 Italian comedy directed by Ettore Scola, known for its very long title and its 1965 working title.
key_facts: Riusciranno i nostri eroi a ritrovare l'amico misteriosamente scomparso in Africa? is a 1968 Italian comedy film.
The film was directed by Ettore Scola.
The film is internationally released as Will Our Heroes Be Able to Find Their Friend Who Has Mysteriously Disappeared in Africa?.
Production of the film started in 1965.
The film's working title was "Mister Sabatini, suppongo" ("Mister Sabatini, I suppose").
The film inaugurated in Italy a brief vogue of kilometric titles.
